column1: # The FIXED LEFT SIDE of acceptance criterion 2. The relation is SET EQUALITY,
# not coverage: coverage passes for a regex that selects zero records, and it
# also passes for `predicate OR prompt == "hello"` at 56 fires.
# Every row is a non-meta HUMAN record on which the shipped hook fires:
# The prompts themselves are NOT reproduced here. They are Scott's raw typed
# text; the quoted trigger is the only fragment the hook itself emits.
# SNAPSHOT (frozen, because the corpus grows during a run and a live re-walk is
#   extraction     type == "user", isSidechain false, content is a string or a
#                  block list with no tool_result (text blocks joined; an
#   reproducer     freeze.py then replay.py, both in this directory. replay.py
#                  invokes the real hook once per record: there is no second
#                  copy of the predicate in the measurement.
# RESULT: 48 non-meta human fires, 0 across all 6,843 non-human records.
# The doc's figure is 46, measured in panel round 3 on an 18,048-record
# extraction. Both extra fires are accounted for, and neither is a predicate
# change. Restricting this snapshot to records older than round 3's fold commit
# (2026-09-18 00:52:01 -0700) and folding the phrase arm case-sensitively
# reproduces 46 / 0 exactly, and the same restriction reproduces the doc's
# denominators (isMeta 2,052 and security-review 1,862 to the record).
#   00938fec-...:543   NEW RECORD. Written 06:25 local on 2026-09-18, after
#   59d90b84-...:94    CASE. Reads "A COPY AND PASTE FROM THE PREVIOUS SESSION",
#                      shouted, so it matches only because the phrase arm folds
#                      case. The doc enumerates the phrase list in lower case
#                      and never states the folding; Phase 0's committed
#                      implies case-sensitive. That is the same defect the doc
#                      caught on the id arm (prose form scores 50, not 46),
#                      unfixed on the phrase arm. Settled case-insensitive: the
#                      doc's `The predicate` now states the folding per arm and
#                      AC2 pins 48 / 0 on this snapshot with both divergences
